mainEntity.name: What business information is unsafe to paste into an AI tool?

acceptedAnswer.text: Do not put passwords, payment details, private customer records, confidential plans, or proprietary source material into an AI tool without checking its data practices and business suitability. Use minimum necessary information, remove identifying details where possible, restrict account permissions, and keep sensitive records in systems designed for them. Small-business guidance specifically warns against feeding sensitive or proprietary information into free AI tools. Run My AI Biz’s workflows emphasize secure account connections and owner approval. Create a simple data policy listing what AI may receive, what it may not receive, and who reviews outputs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Treat passwords, payment data, private customer records, confidential plans, and proprietary material as restricted. Check tool policies, minimize shared data, remove identifiers where possible, limit permissions, and define approved uses in writing.
